evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertion of what the test does — asserted and ready to defend, but no ratification or operational rule performing a settling.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule with modal 'must' stated twice — a settled, load-bearing constraint the speaker expects to be acted on, not merely argued for.
